query:
-- Count of newly enqueued blast rows
SELECT COUNT(*) as enqueued FROM leadSequenceQueue 
WHERE createdBy = 'blast_jun09_2026';

-- First 5 entries with lead name and email for spot-check
SELECT q.id, q.leadId, l.parentName, l.email, l.kidName, q.scheduledFor, q.status
FROM leadSequenceQueue q
JOIN leads l ON l.id = q.leadId
WHERE q.createdBy = 'blast_jun09_2026'
ORDER BY q.id ASC
LIMIT 5;
